EmailTemplate.name: Case Management FASS CAP missing documents
EmailTemplate.subject: RE: {!Case.Subject}
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Dear {!Contact.FirstName},
I just left you a voice message at [PHONE NUMBER] but I wanted to follow up by email as well. It looks like you’re interested in participating in the Starbucks College Achievement Plan, but you haven’t yet completed your financial aid file. If you have any questions, or if there’s anything I can do to help get you started, please let me know. This is such a great opportunity; I don’t want you to miss out! Just remember, the single most important thing you’ll need to do to even be eligible for the scholarship, is complete the FAFSA. You can go to fafsa.ed.gov and complete it online with a copy of last year’s tax return. Once you’ve done that, just be sure to submit any requested documents each new academic year.
You can use the “Financial Aid and Scholarships” box, located on the “Finances” tab of MyASU to see what your next steps are in completing your aid file. If you have questions or need assistance, reply to this email or call Financial Aid and Scholarship Services at 1-844-ASU-6693.
Sincerely, {!User.FirstName} {!User.LastName}
Financial Aid and Scholarship Services Arizona State University PO Box 870412 Tempe, AZ 85287-0412 Phone: 1-844-278-6693
If you have any additional information or questions related to this, please reply to this email.
